protocol: Five fixed Lua sources, 5,000,000 loop iterations per fresh CLI process; nine rotated/reversed triples per fixture, plus one untimed checksum-validated warmup per engine/fixture. Exact stdout, empty stderr and exit status are checked in every child. Wall, GetProcessTimes user/kernel CPU and QueryProcessCycleTime include process launch, compile, startup, execution and cleanup. This compares the ordinary current release CLI with a byte-identical preserved parent CLI pinned by its committed audit and the official C reference pinned by the current audit. No allocator instrumentation or isolated opcode timings; shared host, warm filesystem caches and timer quantization limit small differences.

or_shortcut_true.source: local a,b=true,false;local n=0;for i=1,5000000 do local value=not not(a or b);if value then n=n+1 end end;io.write(n)

or_rhs_false.source: local a,b=false,false;local n=0;for i=1,5000000 do local value=not not(a or b);if value then n=n+1 end end;io.write(n)

and_shortcut_false.source: local a,b=false,true;local n=0;for i=1,5000000 do local value=not not(a and b);if value then n=n+1 end end;io.write(n)

nested_mixed.source: local a,b,c=false,true,false;local n=0;for i=1,5000000 do local value=not not((a and b)or c);if value then n=n+1 end end;io.write(n)

comparison_rhs.source: local a,b,c=false,2,3;local n=0;for i=1,5000000 do local value=not(a or(b<c));if value then n=n+1 end end;io.write(n)

missing_metrics: allocation counts for these focused CLI fixtures

workspace_snapshot.reason: Concurrent main-worktree Cargo manifest/lock edits invalidated prior timing guards; these measurements use an isolated exact Lua-source checkout and fixed build inputs.
